## The Buckle, Inc. Reports October 2026 Net Sales


11/05/2026


Download (opens in new window)


KEARNEY, Neb.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


The Buckle, Inc. (NYSE: BKE) announced today that comparable store net sales, for stores open at least one year, for the 4-week period ended October 31, 2026 decreased 0.5 percent from comparable store net sales for the 4-week period ended November 1, 2025. Net sales for the 4-week fiscal month ended October 31, 2026 increased 1.8 percent to $94.9 million from net sales of $93.2 million for the prior year 4-week fiscal month ended November 1, 2025.


Comparable store net sales for the 13-week third quarter ended October 31, 2026 increased 0.6 percent from comparable store net sales for the 13-week period ended November 1, 2025. Net sales for the 13-week fiscal third quarter ended October 31, 2026 increased 2.6 percent to $329.2 million compared to net sales of $320.8 million for the prior year 13-week fiscal third quarter ended November 1, 2025.


Comparable store net sales year-to-date for the 39-week period ended October 31, 2026 increased 2.5 percent from comparable store net sales for the 39-week period ended November 1, 2025. Net sales for the 39-week fiscal period ended October 31, 2026 increased 4.3 percent to $937.8 million compared to net sales of $898.7 million for the prior year 39-week fiscal period ended November 1, 2025.


The Company will announce third quarter earnings on Friday, November 20, 2026. Management will hold a live audio webcast at 10:00 a.m. EST on November 20, 2026 to discuss results for the quarter. To register for the live event, visit[https://buckle.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_iZVFy_StRI2AfMWfqKCqkg](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fbuckle.zoom.us%2Fwebinar%2Fregister%2FWN_iZVFy_StRI2AfMWfqKCqkg&esheet=54635561&newsitemid=20261105436094&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fbuckle.zoom.us%2Fwebinar%2Fregister%2FWN_iZVFy_StRI2AfMWfqKCqkg&index=1&md5=2e02a2d2f3d2e2a548749f0e5f59dbb1) . A replay of the event can be accessed through Buckle’s investor relations website within twenty-four hours after the conclusion of the live event ([https://corporate.buckle.com/investors/earnings-webcasts](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcorporate.buckle.com%2Finvestors%2Fearnings-webcasts&esheet=54635561&newsitemid=20261105436094&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fcorporate.buckle.com%2Finvestors%2Fearnings-webcasts&index=2&md5=5b1f658775651e45df6f5ac65ab77bc8) ).


**About Buckle**


Buckle is a specialty retailer focused on delivering exceptional service and style through unforgettable experiences. Offering a curated mix of high-quality, on-trend apparel, accessories, and footwear, Buckle is for those living the styled life. Known as a denim destination, each store carries a wide selection of fits, styles, and finishes from leading denim brands, including the Company’s exclusive brand, BKE. Headquartered in Kearney, Nebraska, Buckle currently operates 451 retail stores in 42 states, which includes the opening of one new store located in Edwardsville, Illinois during fiscal October and one new store located in Round Rock, Texas earlier this week (after the fiscal month ended). The Company operated 442 stores in 42 states as of November 5, 2025. To listen to the Company’s recorded monthly sales commentary, please call (308) 238-2500.
